threads.body: Please regenerate and commit the affected GenAI `data.json` files with this mock change, as required by `scenarios/gen-ai/AGENTS.md:59–60`. For example, `scenarios/gen-ai/python/google-genai/opentelemetry-google-genai/data.json:170–188` still records missing response ID and model attributes that this change is intended to supply. Leaving the results unchanged keeps reports stale and causes the committed-coverage check in `.github/workflows/runner.yml:756–762` to fail when regeneration changes them.
